messages:
Alex M: Heads up — PR #17821 (kv-cache refactor) is hitting CI failures: Windows snapshot job + embed-index job. Looks like a snapshot mismatch on `kv_evict` and a transient embed-index flake. Not obvious from the changes. Can someone trigger a targeted rerun and inspect the snapshot delta?

Priya S: On it. Can you paste the failing test name and the build link?

Alex M: Failing test: `kv_cache_eviction_test::EvictAfterFull`
Build: https://ci.example.com/builds/9876
Relevant snippet from the Windows snapshot diff:
```
- Expected: ["key1","key2"]
+ Actual:   ["key1", "key2"]
```
Small whitespace-ish difference but snapshot harness flagged it.

Marta L: If it's purely whitespace we can update snapshots, but let's be careful — the test touches eviction ordering, so we should verify it's only formatting. Post full diff + logs.

Ben K: I can re-run the two failed jobs (windows-snap + embed-index). Queue is a bit backed up right now, but I'll trigger targeted reruns. Is it safe to fast-track merge if reruns go green?

QA Eng: If reruns pass, prefer: 1) another quick rerun or 2) manual review of snapshot diff before approving. If snapshot update is needed, add a changelog entry in the PR body and call out the test that was updated.

CI Bot: buildkite: Re-run started for https://ci.example.com/builds/9876 (jobs: windows-snapshot, embed-index-targeted)

Alex M: Thanks. Also noticed a CI latency spike around 09:13 UTC earlier — some timeouts in unrelated jobs. Might have caused flakiness. @eng-infra FYI. I don't want to add test timeouts as a permanent fix.

Priya S: Rerun finished for embed-index -> PASSED, windows-snapshot -> FAILED (again). Snapshot diff attached: small spacing in serialized arrays.

Marta L: Post the full diff text. If it's only a spacing normalization issue from a serializer change, then snapshot update is fine. If ordering changed, we need deeper investigation.

Alex M: Full diff pasted above; repro locally points to the same whitespace. I ran `pytest tests/kv/test_eviction.py::EvictAfterFull -k EvictAfterFull -q` with the same seed and saw identical output.

Ben K: If it's just whitespace, propose: I run `./scripts/update-snapshots --filter kv_evict` in a branch, push, and mark for review. We should still have one approval before merge. @Ben K pinged for review. :eyes:

QA Eng: Agree. Also request adding a short note in PR: "snapshot update: whitespace normalization — validated by reruns X/2" so we have an audit trail for the update.

Alex M: I'll create the snapshot-update branch and link here. Please review quickly, Ben.

Ben K: I'll review in ~20m and push an approval if everything looks mechanical.

CI Bot: buildkite: Re-run started for https://ci.example.com/builds/9876 (full pipeline)

CI Bot: buildkite: All jobs passed for build 9876 — windows-snapshot, embed-index, integration.

Marta L: Thanks everyone. Since reruns are green and diffs are formatting-only, let's proceed with snapshot update workflow and one reviewer sign-off.

Alex M: Branch: `pr/17821/snap-update-whitespace` — pushed commit `a1b2c3d`. Link: https://repo.example.com/pulls/17821

Ben K: Reviewed and approved. Merging after CI stays green for another 5m window. :thumbsup:

QA Eng: Note added to PR body per checklist.

Alex M: Merged. Thanks all for the quick triage. Will follow up with eng-infra on the CI spike separately.
